sourceTitle: Trail Mix Bars with Xocai Healthy Dark Chocolate
sourceText:
Trail Mix Bars with Xocai Healthy Dark Chocolate
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Monday, June 4, 2012 - 3:37pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup butter
4 cups marshmallows
4 cups Assorted HEALTHY Cereals
4 cups Assorted Mixed Nuts, or trail mix, with or without dried fruit
1/2 cup Xocai Healthy Chocolate Sipping Xocolate

Preparation

1 Melt butter and marshmallows in a large pot on the stove. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients ans stir well. Press mixture into 9x13 inch pan and let cool. Makes 30 pieces
